appDescription: A family location sharing app that guides the car to a family member's live location for pickups.

function.name: START_PICKUP
function.description: Start a pickup by navigating to a family member's live location and notifying that member's phone.

memberName.description: Name or family role of the member to pick up, as registered in the family group.

function.name: STOP_PICKUP
function.description: Stop the pickup in progress and end navigation to the family member.

function.name: GET_MEMBER_LOCATION
function.description: Tell where a family member is and how far away the member is when a pickup is in progress.

memberName.description: Name or family role of the member to locate, as registered in the family group.
